pages.text: $(bold)Serene Seasons$() is on: crops only grow in their seasons. Check the crop's tooltip, and craft a $(bold)Calendar$() to see the season.$(br2)Farmer villagers replant (Smarter Farmers). Chickens use nests (Incubation).
An $(bold)enchanting room$() with Easy Magic: the table keeps your lapis and item inside, and you can re-roll the offered enchantments. See $(l:overworld/enchanting)Enchanting$(/l).
